item.text: The command startup skips `config.Load` when no file is found, so env overrides never reach the running config. The loader also always tries to read a file. I’ll make empty-path loading valid and have startup use it for defaults.
The loader and startup changes are in place. I added regression tests for empty-path defaults, env overrides, and env precedence over file values; the targeted Go tests are running now.

item.text:
Fixed the default-config path. `config.Load("")` now applies `FLIPT_` environment overrides to defaults, and startup calls the loader even when no config file is found. File values still form the base when a path is provided.

Added regression tests for `FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL`, `FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT`, and file precedence. `go test ./internal/config ./cmd/flipt` passes.
